_note: SpeedKills' profile (src/game/game.ts, docs/PHASE_18_PLAN_SPEEDKILLS.md section 6): what is in play and the design that differs from the legacy game. Selection and design only: the numbers that describe a thing (a gun's damage, a jump's height) stay in their own configs, and a gun here is a legacy gun (`from`) with its own name, family and fixed optic, tuned by overlays in Phase 20. Every id named here must exist (tools/checks/games.ts). A first version, to be tuned in play. Ours.
name: SpeedKills
_roster: About two guns per family, each pair answering 'why this one' at a glance (the brief, sections 10 and 11): a hard-hitter and a fast one. Six families; the sniper and the heavy have one gun each to start.
_weapons: Each gun's SpeedKills name, its role in its pair (hard or fast), and the one optic it always wears (attachments are off in SpeedKills: fusion is the upgrade). The names are proposals for the owner (plan section 11).
_ammo: One universal ammo for every gun, in generous stacks: the owner's rule is that nobody runs out (plan section 11, decision 4).
_fusion: A duplicate raises a gun one level, 1 to 5; each level's multipliers against level 1. A level-5 gun is better, not decisive: the TTK check (Phase 20) holds its time to kill within about 15% of level 1's. A duplicate ability core lowers that ability's cooldown by cooldownStep a level, to abilityLevels.
_abilities: Seven abilities in two slots: pick one mobility and one utility before the match, and in the battle royale their cores on the floor fuse or swap (plan section 11, decision 1). `from` is the legacy ability each is built on (null: new). No passives and no ultimates: fewer things to learn and to read in a fight.

set.blurb: Heal over a few seconds. A hit cancels it.

_life: The death lifecycle (plan section 5.8): no knockdowns; the first death goes to the Gulag, a later one makes a ghost, whom a squad mate revives at the ghost's echo point in reviveSeconds, awaySlowdown times as long while the ghost is further than followRadius metres from the reviver. A squad is out when none of it is alive or in the Gulag. In solo there is nobody to revive a ghost, so a second death is the end.
_bots: Five tiers, easiest first; the first three map onto the legacy tiers, and beginner and extreme are new (Phase 27).
